description: Downloads a set of files referenced by File API URLs, bundles them into a single archive (ZIP or TAR with gzip/bzip2/xz compression), uploads the archive back to the File API, and returns a downloadable reference to it.

parameters.description: Parameters for the compress compute task.

compression_level.description: Compression level (0-9), higher means smaller output but slower. Applies to 'zip', 'tar.gz', 'tar.bz2', and 'tar.xz'. Not supported for 'zip-stored' and 'tar'. Defaults to the format's default level.
compression_level.title: Compression Level

destination.description: File API reference (path- or id-based URL) specifying where the resulting archive should be uploaded.
destination.title: Destination

files.description: File API references (URLs) for the files to include in the archive.

items.description: File API reference (URL) for a file to include in the archive.
items.title: Input File

files.title: Input Files

output_name.description: Friendly name of the resulting archive returned in the task results.
output_name.title: Output Name

parameters.title: CompressParameters

results.description: Results for the compress compute task.

output.description: Reference to the uploaded archive, which can be downloaded via the File API.

name.description: The name of the file, typically the terminal segment of the path.
name.title: File Name

output.title: Archive

results.title: CompressResults
